name: Austral-Hamada

civilization.name: The Pale Assemblies
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws dust seas stretching to the horizon, patient as erosion itself.
The air carries burnt sugar and sulfur, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Instruments disagree about the spatial rift remnant: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
